title: Privacy policy
intro: {{appName}} is a personal finance app. This page explains what data it keeps, why, and what you can do about it.

who.title: Who looks after your data
who.body: {{appName}} and the data kept in it are the responsibility of the project's developer, a private individual. For more information, write to <contact/>, which also handles any request about your data.

data.title: What we keep
data.account: For your account: name, email, the date it was created and the password, kept only as a hash (a form that cannot be turned back into the original password).
data.pending: When you ask to sign up: your name and email, only until you confirm through the link in the email (at most 2 days); without the confirmation, no account is created and the request is deleted.
data.finances: What you record: income, expenses, categories, vaults, goals, deposits and withdrawals, with amount, date and description.
data.google: If you sign in with Google: your Google account identifier, to recognize you next time. From Google we receive only your name and email; we have no access to anything else in your Google account, and an account created through Google has no password.
data.import: If you import a bank statement: the file is read only on your device and is not uploaded. We keep only the transactions you confirm and, in each one, a mark (a hash) made from the bank code, the last 4 digits of the account and the transaction's identifier in the statement, so the same one is not imported again. The full account number is not stored.
data.nothingElse: We do not keep documents, bank details, cards or your location.

use.title: What we use it for
use.body: Only to show your finances to you and for your account's email messages: the sign-up confirmation, password changes and security notices. These messages are sent by Resend, an email delivery service, which receives only the address and the text of each one. Other than that, we do not sell or share your data, show ads, or use third-party analytics or tracking.

browser.title: What stays in your browser
browser.body: Your session (so you stay signed in), and the theme and language you chose and, if you import a CSV, which column of the file is which (never the statement's content), and the values you type in the contribution simulator, until you sign out. If you install {{appName}} as an app, the browser keeps only the app's own files, never your financial data. We do not use tracking cookies. On the screens with the Google button (sign in, create account and settings), the button is loaded from Google's servers, which follow Google's own privacy policy.

security.title: How we protect it
security.body: The connection is always encrypted (HTTPS), the password is kept as a hash, each person can only reach their own data, and sign-in attempts are limited. Sessions expire after one hour, and in Settings you can sign out of all devices at once.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: As long as your account exists. When you delete your account, your data is removed from the database right away. Database backups are kept for {{backupRetentionDays}} days and then deleted.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD), you can confirm what data we have, ask for a copy, correct it and ask for it to be deleted. You can download a copy of all your data and delete your account yourself in Settings. For other requests, use the contact above.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If this policy changes, the date at the top of the page changes too.
